Two modules for logs, analytics and exports.

- `user-agent-parser.wasm`: browser, operating system, device type and engine from user-agent strings, with bots and HTTP libraries flagged so they can be filtered out
- `csv-writer.wasm`: records to CSV with any delimiter, decimal commas, chosen columns and headers, nested fields, a byte-order mark for Excel, and protection against spreadsheet formula injection on by default

The other modules are unchanged. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
